name: Stew Multi-Pull
description: Adds "Purchase x{{count}}" to the Mushroom Club's stew menu: {{count}} decal pulls in a row. It costs {{count}} pulls' worth, and you need all of it to start. The stew animation plays once instead of {{count}} times, and all {{count}} decals show together in a grid at the end. With its plugin, lid-stewpull.dll, the whole run is one request - paid, drawn and saved once - so it is about as quick as one pull.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Pulls per purchase
settings.help: How many decals one "Purchase" in the new menu entry pulls. Each costs the normal price, so 25 costs 25 pulls' worth of Kill Coins (or Death Metals), and you need it all before it starts.

patches.description: Purchase x{{count}} in the stew menu, its price, and its decals in one grid (BrgGame.upk)
